listening.imageAlt: Nhiều con sứa với xúc tu cam trôi trong bể, một con tròn màu cam lớn ở bên phải

audio.text: Some jellyfish are resting on the sand.
A net is being lowered into the tank.
An orange jellyfish is floating on the right side.
Some jellyfish are lined up in a row.

options: Some jellyfish are resting on the sand.
A net is being lowered into the tank.
An orange jellyfish is floating on the right side.
Some jellyfish are lined up in a row.

why.vi: Con sứa cam lớn nằm ở bên phải ảnh nên (C) đúng. Sứa trôi tự do, không xếp hàng.
why.en: A big orange jellyfish drifts on the right, so (C) is right. The jellyfish are not in a row.

questions.trap: Câu (D) 'lined up in a row' nghe hợp với nhiều con sứa, nhưng chúng nằm rải rác.

listening.imageAlt: Một con sứa có đốm trắng, xúc tu buông xuống, trôi trong nước đen

audio.text: A diver is photographing a jellyfish.
A jellyfish with white spots is floating in the dark water.
A jellyfish is being weighed on a scale.

options: A diver is photographing a jellyfish.
A jellyfish with white spots is floating in the dark water.
A jellyfish is being weighed on a scale.

why.vi: Con sứa có đốm trắng đang trôi trong nước tối, nên (B) đúng. Không có thợ lặn hay cân.
why.en: A spotted jellyfish floats in dark water, so (B) fits. No diver or scale is visible.

questions.trap: Câu (D) lấy ý có hơn một con (một con nhỏ ở mép phải) nhưng không ai đang tách chúng.

listening.imageAlt: Nhiều con sứa hồng và cam trôi trong bể, cột kính thẳng đứng bên trái và ánh đèn xanh lá bên phải

audio.text: A glass panel is being replaced.
Some jellyfish are being fed by a worker.
Many jellyfish are drifting in a tank.

options: A glass panel is being replaced.
Some jellyfish are being fed by a worker.
Many jellyfish are drifting in a tank.

why.vi: Rất nhiều sứa đang trôi trong bể nên (C) đúng. Không có người cho ăn hay thay kính.
why.en: Many jellyfish drift in a tank, so (C) is correct. No worker is feeding or replacing anything.

questions.trap: Câu (A) lấy tấm kính trong ảnh làm bẫy, nhưng không ai đang thay nó.

listening.imageAlt: Bể đầy sứa trong suốt màu xanh, chen chúc nhau

audio.text: A tank is being cleaned with a brush.
Fish are being counted by an inspector.
A lid is being placed on the tank.
The tank is crowded with jellyfish.

options: A tank is being cleaned with a brush.
Fish are being counted by an inspector.
A lid is being placed on the tank.
The tank is crowded with jellyfish.

why.vi: Bể có rất nhiều sứa chen chúc nên 'is crowded with' đúng. Không có người nào làm việc.
why.en: The tank is packed with jellyfish, so (D) is right. No one is working.

questions.trap: Câu (A), (B), (C) đều là bị động cần có người làm việc, mà ảnh không có ai.

listening.imageAlt: Một con sứa màu cam nhạt bơi trong một thùng tròn có đáy trắng

audio.text: Some jellyfish are being poured into a bucket.
A single jellyfish is floating in a round container.

options: Some jellyfish are being poured into a bucket.
A single jellyfish is floating in a round container.

why.vi: Chỉ có một con sứa đang trôi trong thùng tròn nên (D) đúng. Không có khách hay ai đổ sứa vào xô.
why.en: One jellyfish floats in a round container, so (D) is correct. No visitors or pouring appear.

questions.trap: Câu (A) gần với hoạt động chăm sóc sứa nhưng không ai đang đổ sứa vào xô.

listening.imageAlt: Một con sứa lớn màu hồng cam ở giữa ảnh, vài con nhỏ và nhạt xung quanh

audio.text: The jellyfish are being sorted by size.
A net is being used to catch small ones.
A smaller jellyfish is being swallowed by a bigger one.
A large jellyfish is floating among smaller ones.

options: The jellyfish are being sorted by size.
A net is being used to catch small ones.
A smaller jellyfish is being swallowed by a bigger one.
A large jellyfish is floating among smaller ones.

why.vi: Con lớn đang trôi giữa những con nhỏ hơn nên (D) đúng. Không có ai phân loại hay dùng lưới.
why.en: The large jellyfish floats among smaller ones, so (D) is correct. No one is sorting or netting them.

questions.trap: Câu (C) nghe hợp vì có con lớn và con nhỏ, nhưng chúng không ăn nhau trong ảnh.

why.vi: Where hỏi chỗ; 'Across from the post office' trả lời.
why.en: 'Where' asks for a place, and 'Across from the post office' gives it.

questions.trap: (A) liên quan thuốc nhưng không chỉ chỗ.

audio.text: Who's in charge of the volunteer schedule?

why.vi: Who hỏi người; Ms. Ortega là người phụ trách.
why.en: 'Who' asks for a person, and Ms. Ortega is one.

questions.trap: (A) lặp lịch nhưng nói tần suất.

audio.text: When will the new exhibit open?

why.vi: When hỏi thời gian; 'Sometime in April' trả lời.
why.en: 'When' asks for a time, and 'Sometime in April' gives it.

questions.trap: (B) là địa điểm.

audio.text: How do I get a parking permit?
Fill out a form at the front desk.

options: Fill out a form at the front desk.

why.vi: How hỏi cách; 'Fill out a form' là cách xin thẻ.
why.en: 'How' asks for a method, and filling out a form is one.

questions.trap: (B) nói về bãi đỗ xe, không nói cách xin.

audio.text: Why did the tour group arrive late?

why.vi: Why hỏi lý do; 'Their bus broke down' giải thích.
why.en: 'Why' asks for a reason, and the broken-down bus explains it.

questions.trap: (C) trả lời When.

audio.text: Do you need help with those boxes?
Thanks, they're heavier than they look.

options: Thanks, they're heavier than they look.

why.vi: Chấp nhận gián tiếp: cảm ơn và giải thích vì sao cần giúp.
why.en: It accepts indirectly: thanks, plus the reason help is needed.

questions.trap: (B) lặp help nhưng nói về quầy hỗ trợ.

audio.text: Which supplier offered the better price?
The one we used last year.

options: The one we used last year.

why.vi: Which hỏi chọn; 'The one we used last year' xác định.
why.en: 'Which' asks for an identification, and 'The one we used last year' gives it.

questions.trap: (B) lặp price nhưng không chọn nhà cung cấp.

audio.text: What do you think of the new logo?
I'd like to see it in color.

options: I'd like to see it in color.

why.vi: What do you think hỏi ý kiến; 'I'd like to see it in color' là phản hồi chưa hẳn đồng ý.
why.en: 'What do you think' asks for an opinion, and wanting to see color is a cautious reply.

questions.trap: (C) nghe giống logo/logged.

audio.text: Would you like me to book a table for lunch?
Thanks, I already made a reservation.

options: Thanks, I already made a reservation.

why.vi: Lời đề nghị; 'I already made a reservation' từ chối vì đã làm.
why.en: An offer, and 'I already made a reservation' declines because it is done.

questions.trap: (A) nghe giống table/tablet.

audio.text: Why isn't the jellyfish tank lit up today?

why.vi: Why hỏi lý do; 'The bulbs are on order' giải thích.
why.en: 'Why' asks for a reason, and the bulbs being on order explains it.

questions.trap: (B) lặp light nhưng nghĩa khác.

audio.text: When should I submit the overtime form?
It's due before the payroll cut-off.

options: It's due before the payroll cut-off.

why.vi: When hỏi thời hạn; 'before the payroll cut-off' trả lời.
why.en: 'When' asks for a deadline, and 'before the payroll cut-off' gives it.

questions.trap: (A) trả lời Where.

audio.text: Where can I charge my phone?
There's an outlet by the pillar.

options: There's an outlet by the pillar.

why.vi: Where hỏi chỗ; 'an outlet by the pillar' chỉ chỗ.
why.en: 'Where' asks for a place, and 'an outlet by the pillar' gives one.

questions.trap: (B) lặp charge nhưng nghĩa khác (miễn phí).

audio.text: How come the café is so quiet today?
Half the neighborhood is at the festival.

options: Half the neighborhood is at the festival.

why.vi: How come nghĩa là Why; 'at the festival' là lý do.
why.en: 'How come' means 'why', and the festival is the reason.

questions.trap: (A) lặp quiet nhưng không giải thích.

audio.text: I can look at it after lunch.

options: I can look at it after lunch.

why.vi: Lời nhờ; 'I can look at it after lunch' đồng ý.
why.en: A request, and 'I can look at it after lunch' agrees.

questions.trap: (C) nghe giống proofread/proof.

audio.text: Who's responsible for the leaking pipe?
The plumber is on his way.

options: The plumber is on his way.

why.vi: Who hỏi người chịu trách nhiệm; 'Building management' trả lời.
why.en: 'Who' asks about responsibility, and building management answers.

questions.trap: (A) liên quan ống nước nhưng không nói ai chịu trách nhiệm.

audio.text: Is it all right if I leave a little early?
As long as the report is done.

options: As long as the report is done.

why.vi: Xin phép; 'As long as the report is done' đồng ý có điều kiện.
why.en: A request for permission, and 'As long as the report is done' grants it with a condition.

questions.trap: (C) lặp little nhưng trái nghĩa.

audio.text: What's the fee for a late return?

why.vi: Fee là phí; 'Two dollars a day' nêu phí trả muộn.
why.en: 'Fee' means a charge, and 'Two dollars a day' states it.

questions.trap: (A) nghe giống fee/fine nhưng không nói số tiền.

audio.text: Why don't we ask the guide to speak a bit slower?
Some visitors are struggling to follow.

options: Some visitors are struggling to follow.

why.vi: Đồng ý gợi ý bằng lý do: một số khách khó theo kịp.
why.en: It supports the suggestion with a reason.

questions.trap: (B) lặp slow nhưng nói về ngày.

audio.text: How long has the tank been out of service?
Since the pump failed last Friday.

options: Since the pump failed last Friday.

why.vi: How long hỏi khoảng thời gian; 'Since the pump failed' trả lời.
why.en: 'How long' asks for a duration, and 'Since the pump failed' gives it.

questions.trap: (B) lặp service nhưng nói giờ bắt đầu.

audio.text: Where do you keep the visitor log?

why.vi: Where hỏi chỗ; 'at the security desk' trả lời.
why.en: 'Where' asks for a place, and the security desk is one.

questions.trap: (A) lặp visitor nhưng không chỉ chỗ.

audio.text: Wasn't there supposed to be a demonstration this afternoon?
It was moved to tomorrow morning.

options: It was moved to tomorrow morning.

why.vi: Câu hỏi phủ định; 'moved to tomorrow morning' cho biết thay đổi.
why.en: 'It was moved to tomorrow morning' answers the negative question.

questions.trap: (A) lặp afternoon nhưng không nói gì về buổi trình diễn.

audio.text: I can't believe the shipment is late again.

why.vi: Phàn nàn; 'switch carriers' là đề xuất xử lý.
why.en: A complaint, and switching carriers is a sensible response.

questions.trap: (B) lặp believe nhưng không hợp ngữ cảnh.

audio.text: Who should I ask about the school group booking?
Whoever is at the front desk can help.

options: Whoever is at the front desk can help.

why.vi: Who hỏi người; 'Whoever is at the front desk' chỉ người trực.
why.en: 'Who' asks for a person, and 'Whoever is at the front desk' points to one.

questions.trap: (A) lặp book/group nhưng nói đã đặt phòng.

audio.text: Would you mind if I borrowed your notes from the meeting?
The notes were not at all long.
Not at all, they're in the blue folder.

options: The notes were not at all long.
Not at all, they're in the blue folder.

why.vi: 'Would you mind' xin phép; 'Not at all' nghĩa là không phiền, đồng ý.
why.en: 'Would you mind' asks permission, and 'Not at all' agrees.

questions.trap: (B) lặp 'not at all' nhưng nói về độ dài.

audio.text: Do you think the proposal will be approved or sent back for revision?
The board has been asking for details.

options: The board has been asking for details.

why.vi: Trả lời gián tiếp: hội đồng đang đòi chi tiết nên có thể bị trả lại.
why.en: An indirect reply: the board wants details, so revision is likely.

questions.trap: (A) lặp approve nhưng không chọn.
